headline: Senators’ Cousins leaves game after hit from Capitals’ Chychrun
take: Daily Faceoff reports Nick Cousins left Tuesday's game after a hit from Jakob Chychrun, with no penalty called on the play. It came on an awkward night for Ottawa: the Senators had 70 shot attempts to Washington's 40 and by our replay deserved the game 63% of the time, then lost 3-2 in overtime. Losing Cousins for any stretch thins a forward group that has kept Ottawa at 11-6-2 with roughly even chances (52% of the expected goals, the quality of chances). The Senators' record has run a little behind their play this season, about three goals short on finishing. If Cousins misses time, watch who the coach moves up; depth scoring is where Ottawa has been leaving goals on the table.
